name: Surface Channel Definition
definition: Specifies the channel defining the fluid surface for solid rendering and displacement. Used in Mesh, Ocean Mesh, Cap Mesh, Isosurface modes. Also denotes surface for Gradient and Surface-driven displacement in all modes.
summary: Surface Channel Definition specifies which volumetric data channel defines the fluid's surface geometry for rendering, distinct from gradient-driven displacement by relying on a specific channel's scalar value rather than density gradients.
